737050102.text: Welcome to the home base of the "Fieldwise Center"!

737050103.text: As you can see, the core projects are already up and running, so we can get to work at any time!

737050104.text: Huh... This feels like... one of those places light novels talk about. Y'know, the adventuring hubs where rookies gather to take quests and stuff?

737050105.text: Oh! And almost like a school festival at the same time, with everyone getting together to learn and then forming teams to hone their skills... Hehe, it's so exciting!

737050108.text: Well, this place isn't quite as decked out as a school festival, but Master Tighnari said the Akademiya plans to be generous with the resources.

737050109.text: Anyway, before students and researchers head out on dangerous field missions, they can come here for advice and emergency training...

737050110.text: We even have professionals on staff that can join their teams to serve as guides or safety personnel.

737050111.text: Yeah, you can think of it like a "Forward Operating Base" — equal parts theoretical training and field practice!

737050112.text: We'll familiarize new recruits with potential challenges in the wild and take them through drills so there's no reason to panic during the real thing!
